Name: AutoForager
Author: DebugDew
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b][color=#FFD54F]✨ AutoForager ✨[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][i]The ultimate automation tool for your daily chores![/i][/size]
[/center]

[size=4]Let [color=#FFD54F][b]AutoForager[/b][/color] handle your daily collection tasks automatically! Gather forage, truffles, tapper products, farm cave items, mushroom logs, trash can loot, and crab pots without lifting a finger. Built for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b].[/size]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#6EC6FF]🌟 Core Features[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Daily Automations:[/b][/color] Collects wild forage, bushes, moss, tree fruits/seeds, artifacts, trash, mushroom logs, tappers, and crab pots every morning. Sweeps truffles and crab pots every evening.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Smart Storage System:[/b][/color] Assign a [color=#66CCFF][b]Main[/b][/color] and [color=#66CCFF][b]Backup[/b][/color] chest for every category. Specific items (Mushrooms, Beach, Bushes) automatically fall back to the Forage chest if no sub-chest is set.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Overflow Protection:[/b][/color] If all assigned chests are full, items safely stay in their original location. Nothing is ever lost or deleted.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Visual Helpers:[/b][/color] Hold the overlay key ([i]Default: Left Alt[/i]) to see category labels floating above your chests. Get HUD alerts for full or missing chests.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#6EC6FF]📦 Setup & Map Tracking[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Custom Assignment UI:[/b][/color] Stand near a chest and press [b]J[/b] (default) to open an easy-to-use menu. Link or reset your chests with a single click.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Auto Map Detection:[/b][/color] If a map has forageable items, trees, or bushes, the mod will [b]automatically[/b] track it as soon as you enter.[/size][/*]
[*][color=#58A6FF][size=4][b]Manual Tracking:[/b][/size][/color][size=4] Custom indoor maps (like modded greenhouses, basements, or custom caves) cannot be detected automatically. Stand inside one and press [/size][b][size=4]F5[/size][/b][size=4] to manually add it to your tracking list![/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#58A6FF][b]Fully Customizable:[/b][/color] Change hotkeys, collection times, and toggle features via the [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b].[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#6EC6FF]🔌 Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Fully compatible with major expansion mods ([b]Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp[/b]), custom items ([b]Cornucopia, Alchemistry[/b]), and profession overhauls ([b]Walk Of Life[/b]). Works seamlessly with any custom indoor map thanks to the new manual tracking feature.[/size]
